status: post-hoc exploratory; frozen before running these new sensitivities, after the original results were known; not a prospective preregistration
scope: Public processed-source sensitivity only. Preserve all original scripts, manifests, and historical execution checks.
inputs: Use only source bytes verified against ../input_manifest.json. Original output snapshots are comparators, never calculation inputs.

ptc.selection: Re-read complete Supp_Table 3. UGA context = up_123nt + down_123nt; minimum six-base Hamming distance to gagagt, selected without response values.
estimands: median of within-row gentamicin minus untreated percentage-point differences
sensitivity: leave out every nearest measured row once
leave out all rows sharing each unique nearest six-base context once
report difference of marginal medians separately; do not mislabel as median paired increment
ptc.missing_censoring: Emit complete, missing, left/right-censored counts. Do not treat censored bounds as exact values; main sensitivity requires all nearest paired values observed and uncensored, otherwise report insufficient and stop that calculation.
ptc.interpretation: Report full leave-out ranges and direction changes. These are finite-set influence diagnostics, not uncertainty intervals, new biological replicates, genotype predictions or clinical effects. No threshold-based drug promotion.

gse65145.anchor: Archived canonical BUB1B NM_001211.6 hg19 span, selected by annotation only.
gse65145.feature_selection: For every threshold report all qualifying rows in boundary-distance order. Empty sets are insufficient, not zero signal. Report all locus-overlapping rows as non-specific audit only; never promote partial/oversized overlaps to BUB1B estimates.
estimators: ratio of geometric condition means if all values strictly positive
sensitivity: leave each of six samples out once and recompute arithmetic contrasts, with remaining sample counts
report all four cross-condition sample ratios as unpaired descriptive range, not matched-pair inference
gse65145.aggregation: For each overlap threshold, report range and median across qualifying feature ratios only as redundant locus summaries, not independent evidence.
gse65145.descriptive_state_comparison: Report log2(Rap/Pro), log2(Qui/Pro), log2(Rap/Qui) for qualifying features. Opposite/same direction is descriptive; serum restriction and rapamycin are not cell-cycle matched. No regression adjustment, mediation, causal attribution or inferred proliferation correction.
gse65145.genomewide_background: Among deposited features with Pro arithmetic mean >=1 RPKM and strictly positive arithmetic means in all three conditions, report unweighted Spearman correlation between log2(Rap/Pro) and log2(Qui/Pro), directional quadrant counts, and BUB1B primary-feature percentile ranks. Feature rows overlap and are not independent genes; emit no correlation p-value, CI or enrichment test. Shared denominator can induce correlation. This is context only, not a cell-cycle signature or causal confounder correction.

nmd_checkpoint: No new inferential analysis planned. Preserve four deterministic replay comparators and clarify that NMD published permutation values are reused; checkpoint displayed cells remain one representative replicate, not independent biological replicates.

statistics.randomization: none; deterministic exhaustive finite leave-out analyses
statistics.sample_size: GSE65145: 2 samples/condition, one normal fibroblast cell line; robustness operations do not increase n

reporting: Report stable, changes and insufficient separately. Retain negative/inconclusive findings and all specified sensitivities. Exact-genotype functional rescue, physiological exposure and clinical eligibility remain untested.
stop_conditions: nearest paired PTC missing or censored: report insufficient rather than invent values
